data_plan: Metrics: Binance Vision daily archives (data/futures/um/daily/metrics/<SYM>/<SYM>-metrics-<DATE>.zip), free and keyless, every file verified against its published .CHECKSUM (SHA-256) with a manifest recorded by the run. Klines: Binance Vision monthly klines via the programme's verified loader (data_feed.load_dataset, months 2022-01..2026-10; 1h base resampled to 4h/1d per rd/common.load_timeframe) — the same source and loader as the RD panels. Panel 2022-01-01..2026-10-31 for both series. Prep-time proof (2026-11-17): BTCUSDT metrics files for 2021-01-01 (576 rows, checksum verified) and 2026-10-31 (288 rows, checksum verified) downloaded and parsed; earliest-file probe over all CRYPTO30 symbols; first-of-month continuity spot-checks for BTCUSDT/AAVEUSDT at 11 dates across 2022-2026, all present. Panel verification gate (declared in OI_DECLARATION.md): a symbol with > 1% of its daily metrics files missing in the span is excluded by rule and the exclusion reported; any other deviation stops the run. The run is a separate, later step and is NOT part of the declaring PR.

declared_conventions.asof_and_staleness: The OI value at a bar's close is the last metrics snapshot with create_time <= bar close (causal asof — a snapshot is used only at or after its own timestamp). If that snapshot is more than SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_MIN=30 minutes old at the bar close, the bar is not evaluable: Binance publishes snapshots every ~5 minutes, so a staler snapshot marks a feed gap, never a signal. No interpolation anywhere.
declared_conventions.degenerate_cases: If ATR at the signal bar <= 0, or OI at the previous bar close <= 0 or missing, or the signal bar's close-to-close return is exactly zero, the signal produces NO trade.
declared_conventions.panel_scope: Universe = the 25 CRYPTO30 symbols whose Binance Vision metrics coverage starts on or before 2022-01-01, established by a prep-time probe of the actual archives (2026-11-17): BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, BNBUSDT, XRPUSDT, DOGEUSDT, ADAUSDT, LTCUSDT, LINKUSDT, DOTUSDT, TRXUSDT, AVAXUSDT, NEARUSDT, ATOMUSDT, UNIUSDT, ETCUSDT, BCHUSDT, FILUSDT, XLMUSDT, HBARUSDT, ALGOUSDT, VETUSDT, SANDUSDT, MANAUSDT, AAVEUSDT. Excluded by the same mechanical rule (first metrics file after 2022-01-01): OPUSDT (2022-07-01), INJUSDT (2022-10-01), APTUSDT (2023-01-01), ARBUSDT (2023-04-01), SUIUSDT (2023-07-01). Panel 2022-01-01..2026-10-31.
declared_conventions.percentile_construction: rank(dOI_t) = #{defined dOI values in the trailing window (bar t - 365 days, bar t] at the same timeframe, current bar included, with value <= dOI_t} / #{defined dOI values in that window}. Trailing and causal: no value after bar t enters bar t's rank. A bar is evaluable only if its timestamp is >= 2023-01-01 AND >= 95% of the bars in its trailing window have defined dOI (WINDOW_MIN_COVERAGE=0.95).
declared_conventions.position_sizing: Sizing is not part of this family's backtest identity — the bar judges per-trade expectancy / profit factor, which are sizing-invariant. If the candidate ever reaches forward testing it inherits the fleet-standard decided risk package (FWD-006) unchanged, as with SRS and S-RD1.
declared_conventions.signal_bar_flatness: A bar is a signal candidate only if the symbol was flat for the entire bar: no position open at the bar's open and no exit occurred on that bar. Signals arriving while a position is open are skipped; an exit bar is never also a signal bar.

declared_exclusions.funding: Funding is NEVER an input — no funding percentile, level or sign enters the signal, the gates or the exits. Funding cashflows are not modelled either: price-only accounting under the programme cost model, the same harness convention RD-003 declared for its cells.
declared_exclusions.oi_collapse_tail: The OI-collapse tail (percentile rank <= 0.05) is NOT traded. A collapse is positions closing — exhaustion of an existing move, the opposite mechanism to fresh capital committing. Trading it would put a second mechanism inside the same cells; it needs its own declaration if it is ever tested.
declared_exclusions.positioning_ratios: The long/short positioning ratios carried in the metrics files (count_long_short_ratio, sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio, sum_taker_long_short_vol_ratio) are NOT inputs. A positioning-ratio extreme is the crowding state closest to RD-003's funding state; this family's independence claim rests on testing the quantity series (open interest) alone. A positioning-ratio family is a separate declaration.

distinctness_vs_rd003.direction: OPPOSITE. RD-003 FADED its extreme (extreme positive funding -> short; extreme negative -> long). This family FOLLOWS the price direction on OI-surge bars (surge + up bar -> long; surge + down bar -> short). Even on a bar where both states fire, the two families take opposite sides.
distinctness_vs_rd003.empirical_overlap: Measured at prep time (overlap_check.py; BTCUSDT+ETHUSDT, 1d, folds W1-W2 2024-07-01..2025-07-01; 737/737 metrics days loaded per symbol, zero missing): the declared OI-surge trigger fired on 40 days; RD-003's funding-extreme state (trailing-540-print percentile rank >= 0.90 or <= 0.10, asof at the day open) covered 33.1% (BTC) / 36.7% (ETH) of all evaluable days and 40.0% (16/40) of trigger days — 60% of triggers fire entirely outside RD-003's state. On the 16 coincident days this family's FOLLOW direction opposed RD-003's FADE direction on 10 and agreed on 6 (RD-003's additional EMA50 gate not evaluated). Conclusion: correlated states (both are leverage-cycle phenomena), different signal — different input series, no shared term, mostly disjoint trigger days.
distinctness_vs_rd003.entry_state: RD-003 required a funding-percentile extreme AND price extension vs EMA50. This family requires an OI-change percentile extreme AND the sign of the same bar's close-to-close return. No EMA gate, no funding term.
distinctness_vs_rd003.series: RD-003's funding_extremes read the funding RATE — a price (the periodic flow cost of leverage, %/8h) from Binance Vision fundingRate archives. This family reads sum_open_interest — a quantity (the stock of open contracts) from Binance Vision metrics archives. Funding is never an input in any form.

evaluation_bar.bonferroni: one-sided p < 0.05/N at the run-time programme counter; this declaration adds exactly 2 trials (one per cell); if both cells are judged in one run, both are judged at the final N (entering counter + 2) — the stricter reading
evaluation_bar.costs: programme cost model (crypto 16 bps round trip) AND a 2x-cost shadow run (32 bps), both must pass
evaluation_bar.holdout: rd.common.holdout_check must pass (expectancy > 0 on >= 2 symbols with >= 20 OOS trades each AND no symbol contributing > 80% of total net profit)
evaluation_bar.insufficient_trades_wording: if a cell's pooled OOS trades < 200, that cell's verdict is exactly 'insufficient OOS trades'
evaluation_bar.judgement: OOS only, per cell (4h and 1d judged separately, each pooled across the 25-symbol universe); walk-forward folds W1-W5 (2024-07-01..2026-11-01, end exclusive), entry-time attribution; parameters are frozen by this declaration — nothing is selected in-sample
evaluation_bar.multiple_testing: declared programme counter = 3,891 as of 2026-11-17 (discovery census, authoritative); SRS's declared run adds 1 (-> 3,892) when it lands; this declaration adds 2 — the run must state the floor it used

hypothesis: Open interest is the quantity of open perpetual contracts — a stock of committed capital, not a price. When open interest surges to an extreme (top 5% of its own trailing year of bar-over-bar changes), new positions are being opened at an abnormal rate, and the concurrent price direction identifies which side the new capital is on (price up + OI up = new longs; price down + OI up = new shorts). Freshly committed capital persists rather than reversing on the next bar — the programme's own RD-003 verdict (crowded extremes persist/trend rather than revert) is the prior for FOLLOWING extremes instead of fading them. Traded in the direction of the surge bar under a fixed 2.0x/4.0x ATR bracket with a 120-hour max hold, surge-bar direction is claimed to carry enough short-horizon persistence to clear the RD programme bar net of costs.
promotion_path: Passing the bar makes a cell a forward-test CANDIDATE only, under the Phase-3 forward protocol (>= 100 trades AND >= 8 weeks on demo, FWD-006 sizing). Nothing here authorises live trading. Strict OOS PF < 1.2 fails a cell (owner's rule: such families are deleted); both cells failing closes the family.

rules.atr: Wilder ATR(14) over the cell timeframe's bars: TR = max(H-L, |H - prev close|, |L - prev close|); seeded as the simple mean of the first 14 true ranges; then ATR_t = (ATR_{t-1} * 13 + TR_t) / 14. The value at the signal bar t is used for that trade's bracket.
rules.entry_long: surge bar t (rank(dOI_t) >= 0.95, evaluable, symbol flat for the whole bar) with close-to-close return close_t/close_{t-1} - 1 > 0 -> LONG at the open of bar t+1
rules.entry_short: surge bar t with close-to-close return < 0 -> SHORT at the open of bar t+1; return exactly zero -> no trade
rules.exit_order_within_bar: evaluated on every bar from the entry bar onward, in order: gap through stop at the bar open fills at the open; then the stop; gap through target at the bar open fills at the open; then the target (stop before target within a bar — worst case)
rules.frequency: one position at a time per symbol; signals while a position is open are skipped; an exit bar is never also a signal bar
rules.max_hold: MAX_HOLD_HOURS=120 — 30 bars at 4h, 5 bars at 1d, the entry bar counting as bar 1; if no bracket exit has occurred by the max-hold bar's close, exit at that bar's close (bracket checks on that bar run first)
rules.no_lookahead: the percentile rank at bar t uses only dOI values at bars <= t; the OI value at a bar close is an asof over snapshots with create_time <= bar close; entry is at the open of bar t+1, after the signal bar has fully closed
rules.oi_change: dOI_t = OI_t / OI_{t-1} - 1 over consecutive bars of the cell timeframe, OI_t = asof open interest (sum_open_interest) at bar t's close; undefined if either endpoint is missing or OI_{t-1} <= 0
rules.parameters_fixed: OI_PCT_WINDOW_DAYS=365, OI_SURGE_RANK=0.95, WINDOW_MIN_COVERAGE=0.95, SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_MIN=30, ATR_PERIOD=14, SL_ATR_MULT=2.0, TP_ATR_MULT=4.0, MAX_HOLD_HOURS=120 — no other variants are authorised under this declaration; trying variants means new declarations and a higher trial count
rules.stop: entry -/+ SL_ATR_MULT * ATR_t (2.0 x ATR at the signal bar) — long: entry - 2.0*ATR_t; short: entry + 2.0*ATR_t (the programme BR24 bracket form RD-003 used)
rules.target: entry +/- TP_ATR_MULT * ATR_t (4.0 x ATR at the signal bar) — long: entry + 4.0*ATR_t; short: entry - 4.0*ATR_t
rules.timeframes: two cells: 4h and 1d, each pooled across the universe and judged separately
